Name: Balcony (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Update (1.1.0): Note that map size was changed for starter farmhouse and 1st upgrade, which means everything you placed will be shifted by a few tiles. Wait until you have the 2nd house upgrade before you update to avoid this, unless you want the removable dirt area. Otherwise you should be able to get your stuff with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2594]Crop Transplant[/url].

This adds a balcony to your farmhouse with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Indoor Farm[/url]. Decorate and plant some flowers, it's a peaceful place to spend your quiet evenings after all the work is done. The balcony increases in size after each farm house upgrade.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]A few tillable tiles (optional)
[*]Dynamic background
[*]Hang wall decoration from the top of the ceiling  or from the railings (some items might look like they hang in the air)
[*]Choose between outdoor and indoor location - weather, lighting and sound changes, plus beehouses will work if outdoor while you can plant all season crops in garden pots when indoor (default outdoor, may need to restart for changes to apply)
[*]optional greenhouse functionality
[*]choose between a lighter and darker option for the railing and crop border
[/list][b]
Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with everything.
[b]
Credits[/b]
Inspired by some elements from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and Personal Indoor Farm. 1.6. is required.
